records.canonicalEnglish:
As Sion and his companions entered the command room, the man seated at the table ahead of them rose and offered Joe his right hand.
Roy: I'm Brigadier General Roy Bester, commander of Chausnomyu.
Joe: Joe Compson. Most folks call me Scrap Joe.
Roy: I've heard a great deal about you.
The youthful commander smiled as he shook Joe's hand and offered the compliment.
Roy: Sion, Shoko—and you too, Mr. Compson. You're all very fortunate.
Roy: Normally, an illegally built ship like yours would be destroyed on sight, and its crew severely punished...
Joe: ...So that's how it is.
Roy: A perceptive man like you has already worked it out, I see.
Roy: At the direction of Mars Federation Space Navy headquarters, you will be serving as members of Chausnomyu.
Shoko: What?! ...Sion!
Sion: Y-yeah...
Roy: Allow me to introduce Chausnomyu's ace, who will be joining your team.
Roy: Muretts! Come in!
The towering woman entered the command room at Roy's call.
Joe: I see. So she's our minder... our watchdog.
Welda: The word you're looking for is babysitter.
Joe: Not much choice, is there? Can't go against military orders.
Roy: Well, that about sums it up.
Roy: I'll contact you later with your orders.

records.canonicalEnglish:
Roy: It's time for your first assignment.
Brigadier General Bester dimmed the lights, switched on the monitor, and began the briefing.
Roy: First, take a look at this photograph.
An image appeared on the monitor as he spoke.
Roy: Federation intelligence obtained this film while infiltrating a drug syndicate on Zajil.
The photograph showed the inside of a domed growing facility, packed with Kidun plants.
Kidun: a drug introduced from the Zolias Empire. Besides being addictive, it caused severe hallucinations in habitual users.
But its most distinctive effect was biojunk.
Biojunk occurred when a special compound in Kidun triggered genetic mutations, causing rapid evolution and degeneration inside and outside the body.
The symptoms usually led to a gruesome death. But in rare cases—one in tens of thousands—a vicious bio-beast was born instead.
As a result, mass killings had occurred across the Mars Federation over the past two or three months.
Roy: I imagine you already know what you're looking at.
Roy: We've long had unconfirmed reports of a large Kidun plantation run by a drug syndicate on Zajil.
Roy: But the Federation government couldn't obtain conclusive proof. Intelligence agents attempted to infiltrate the organization several times, and every attempt ended in failure.
Joe: So you want us to investigate this drug ring and wipe it out?
Welda: Could you tell us what you know so far?
Roy: Certainly. Here's what we've established.
Roy: The syndicate on Zajil is called Karilas. Its leader is a Myuntos named Tomyu.
Roy: Be careful. All three agents sent in so far have been killed.
Welda: Well, I'll be there. As long as these people don't get in my way, we should be fine.
Sion: ...
Roy: Then I'll be expecting a successful report.
